title: Sticks to everything.. terrible with eggs
text: Sticks to everything.. terrible with eggs. Maybe one of the worst non-stick pans I’ve ever owned. So not worth the Gordon Ramsy hype. Returned.

product_metadata.title: HexClad 10 Inch Hybrid Stainless Steel Frying Pan (Pan)
features: HexClad Cookware combines high quality stainless steel with a laser-etched non-stick surface using our patented hexagonal design to provide ideal hybrid cooking performance. Featuring a tri-ply construction, our cookware has a layer of aluminum encapsulated between two layers of stainless steel for perfect heat distribution.
All HexClad Cookware is completely non-toxic. The cooking surface is a combination of ceramic, diamond dust and stainless steel for the best balance of utility and performance.

Your HexClad 10 Inch Frying Pan and Lid is ready for any kitchen, thanks to compatibility with all types of cooktops including induction, gas, electric and ceramic, as well as being oven-safe at up to 500 degrees Fahrenheit. Please note HexClad Lids are suitable for use up to 400 degrees Fahrenheit only.

Completely non-toxic surface combining ceramic, diamond dust, and stainless steel for a balance of utility and performance. The surface is metal-utensil resistant and cleanable by dishwasher, steel wool pads or scouring (hand-washing is best).
Your purchase includes one HexClad 10 Inch Frying Pan and one matching Glass Lid. The 10 inch Frying Pan measures approximately 10 inches in diameter, 2 inches in height, and 3 pounds in weight.
